visualCharacteristics: A single artwork image, left-aligned by default, that can show a separate mobile rendition and optionally link as a whole. Variants change alignment, inset, or make it a full-width 280px cover banner.
contentPattern: One row: cell 1 holds the desktop (PC) picture, optional cell 2 holds the mobile (SP) picture; a link authored around a picture makes the whole image clickable.
usage: Use it to place one standalone image or illustration, with an optional mobile version, in a content page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for any lone image with PC/SP renditions; pick columns when the image sits beside text.
